name: Mekakare
source:
‘When I woke up, everyone’s eyes were covered?!’

You, an ordinary run-of-the-mill female high-school student, are the protagonist of this story. One day, you have a strange dream and on your way to school, you are transported to another world.

When you regain your consciousness, you are no longer on your way to school, but in a town called Hidden Eyes City. To your surprise, all the people who live in this world have blinding bangs and their eyes are hidden!

They have a tradition of not showing their eyes to anyone other than the person they have pledged to share their future with.

You were at a loss, and had nowhere to go, but with the invitation of a boy you came across there, Azamuki Shigure, and the help of the headmaster of the Hidden Eyes Private School where he attends, you end up enrolling as a student?!

Thus, your new life in this world begins. After interacting with various boys who have their eyes hidden, will you be able to go back to your world?! Or will you actually prefer to remain here?!

And what might be the other ‘secret’ that their eyes hold…?

[Translated from [url=https://twitter.com/mekakare_love]the official Twitter[/url].]
translation:
“醒来时，大家的眼睛都被遮住了？！”

你是一个普普通通的女高中生，也是本作的主人公。某天，你做了个奇怪的梦，前往学校的途中被传送到另一个世界。

恢复意识后，你发现自己不再走在上学路上，而是身处一座名为Hidden Eyes City的城镇。令你惊讶的是，这个世界里的所有居民都留着遮住双眼的刘海！

他们有一项传统：除了与自己约定共度未来的人以外，不向任何人展示双眼。

你手足无措，也无处可去；在偶然遇见的少年Azamuki Shigure邀请下，又得到他就读的Hidden Eyes私立学校校长帮助，最后竟成了这所学校的学生？！

就这样，你在这个世界的新生活开始了。与各式各样遮住双眼的男孩们相处后，你能回到原来的世界吗？还是会更想留在这里？

他们双眼中还藏着什么“秘密”呢……？

[改译自[url=https://twitter.com/mekakare_love]官方Twitter[/url]]
